title: Redwood Academy Workshop Credit Codes (2027)
author: Priya Shah
body:
## Purpose
Attendees of Redwood Academy workshops get a one-time promotional code worth $100 of usage. This page tells Support what to say when someone asks about one.

## What Support can do
- Codes are issued by the Developer Relations team at the workshop. Support can't issue, re-send or extend them.
- A code is redeemed in Console billing settings. An expired or already-used code can't be restored.
- For a lost code, point the attendee to the workshop's follow-up email, which repeats it.

No case is needed for any of these.

_Last reviewed 2027-01-29._
